svg.text: Hudi expression / filter pushdown on master (62bae026)
One column per engine. Read top to bottom: the engine's expression model, whether it goes through Hudi Expression, then partition pruning, metadata-table data skipping and file-reader pushdown.

g.title: org.apache.hudi.common.expression: Expression, Predicates, Literal (typed with InternalSchema Types), BindVisitor.

g.text: as a DataFrame over column stats
before Hudi is called; Hudi only

svg.text: Hudi Expression is used in three places only: Spark partition pruning, Hive / Glue sync filters and
metadata-table key lookups. Everything else runs on each engine's own expression model.
Column-stats data skipping is written three times (Spark DataFrames, Flink evaluators, Trino Domains).
The data-skipping bug families (#20449, oracle #20439, order-breaking casts #19475) live here, per engine.
Index coverage differs per engine: expression index and metadata-table bloom are Spark-only; secondary
index is Spark and Trino; Hive gets no data skipping at all.
Literal typing is per engine: SparkFilterHelper maps to InternalSchema Types (a LocalDate literal is typed
TimestampType while holding epoch days); Flink switches on LogicalTypeRoot; Trino builds Domains.
Spark evaluates partition filters twice (Hudi Expression in hudi-common, then Catalyst), and the
catalog-backed path skips Hudi Expression entirely.
Glue overrides generatePushDownFilter, but no main-code caller was found; Hive sync uses its own.
Both visitors differ only in string quoting.
Predicates, Literal typed with InternalSchema Types; also used inside hudi-common for metadata-table key lookups (Predicates.in / startsWith)
Imported by Spark partition pruning and Hive / Glue sync only. Flink, Trino and hadoop-mr never import it.
